          Tactics

          Defend and repair
          • Losing your suit or either tissue node ends the mission.
          • Follow the tissue markers and hold Repair in range. Gashes keep draining tissue until sealed.
          • Face clear ground to deploy your turret. It slows enemies that it hits. Cover one approach while you defend the other. Hold the turret control at any time to pick it up and drag it to a new spot; release to set it down.
          • Or bring the medic drone (Armory, Companion). It follows you and mends the most damaged suit or tissue node near it, about a point a second, once a suit has gone a moment without being hit. Press the turret control to station it over a spot, again to call it back.
          • Follow organ hazard cues and repair between waves when you can.
          Read enemy attacks
          • Viruses recoil before lunging. Step sideways as they commit.
          • Spores swell before spitting a slow projectile. Move out of its path.
          • Bacilli latch onto tissue. Shoot them off quickly to limit the damage.
          • Shellbacks block shots from the front. Flank them to hit exposed tissue.
          • Splitters release two smaller viruses when killed.
          Mission objectives
          Capillary Junction
          Watch the attack countdown. Between waves, choose inlet reinforcement or a fresh magazine for the next wave. Your turret can be dragged to a new spot at any time. Seal gashes before extraction. Stay for overtime to earn bonus score.
          Heart Valve
          Four valves open one after another, each with spore colonies rooted behind it. Fire through an open valve to hit its colonies, and repair the wound in front of it while it is closed. Sprint and dash between valves; destroy every colony and restore all four wounds to finish.
          Bronchial Fork
          Leave the central airway before exhale. After wave two, reopen both bronchi with Repair. Keep both at 45% integrity or higher through one full breath.
          Gastric Chamber
          Acid surges flood the whole chamber: jump onto a rugae island before it rises and hop between them while it lasts. After wave one, use Repair to close the intake on the west bank. Avoid redirected acid as you cross to the east bank and open the drain with Repair. Watch the exposed lower passage for flanking enemies.
          Intestinal Bend
          The pressure wave sweeps the whole bend: climb a villus terrace to its top two tiers before it reaches you.
          Inner Ear
          Place your turret outside the resonance rings. Pulses slow your suit and jam turrets inside.
          Neural Cortex
          Protect the overloaded node until repairs are available again. Shoot the Mega Virus’s glowing core as its shell opens. Between openings, intercept pathogens and repair tissue.
          Loadouts and checkpoints
          • Compare and equip one part per slot in the armory before deployment or between missions. Body finish and accent color are cosmetic.
          • Equip one field upgrade at each campaign checkpoint. Insulated Suit reduces acid and pressure damage. Turret Stabilizer makes the turret’s slowing effect last longer.
          • Your checkpoint saves completed missions and the chosen field upgrade. The final report shows tissue integrity across the campaign.
          • Mission select lets you choose any arena and field upgrade. Reaching the Mega Virus unlocks its practice fight.
          • Endless holds one arena against waves that keep growing. Every wave brings more, faster, tougher pathogens, and the boss returns every fifth wave.
